name: OverloadedTrainsSimple-reforged
title: Overloaded Trains Simple Reforged (Paranoidal Fork)
author: SEO-master
description: Local Paranoidal fork. Train acceleration follows the real inertia of the carried cargo: item stacks and fluid add mass to the rolling stock weight, so the effect scales with the size of the train and its locomotives. Trains pass curves at no more than a share of their own top speed and slow down smoothly before them. Braking and top speed are otherwise unchanged; rolling stock is never replaced. This fork is not published on the Mod Portal.
